definition: For each best-quote update: e=I(b>=prev_b)*q_b-I(b<=prev_b)*prev_q_b-I(a<=prev_a)*q_a+I(a>=prev_a)*prev_q_a; intervalOFI=sum(e). Original relation is contemporaneous, not a profitable forecast.

gates.feature_minute_policy: Use only full RTH minute bins with no settled crossed/locked quotes, both sides seen, at least1 update each, no>1s gap between quote groups; later freeze feature policy before computing forecast outcomes

native_constraint: NinjaTrader historical TickReplay does not replay historical bid/ask quantity events and OnMarketDepth is not historical. If valid, use separately audited causal feature file with time/hash gates in Backtest; never enable blocked Playback.
same_timestamp: Preserve parquet file order, aggregate side updates; evaluate final bid/ask state only after entire timestamp group. No exchange sequence or cross-level merge asserted.
scope: Audit original L1 Ask/Bid prices and displayed quantities; L2 position/operation stream separately. Never use Last or DailyVolume as quote size.
source_semantics: Decoder keeps stream order within each L1/L2 output but loses shared cross-level ordinal; UTC ns parquet from100ns .NET time. L1 updates are replacement price/size for one side, not signed size deltas. L2 operations need separate ladder reconstruction.
stop_policy: If quote state cannot be reconstructed, record missing fields and stop OFI implementation; do not substitute trade volume. If clean enough, preregister finite lagged feature hypothesis before outcomes. Short sample always deferred.
